Good — only `??` (untracked/new), no existing migrations touched.

Here's what was added across the four files:

**`db/migrations/003_add_task_priority.sql`** — adds the column with a `CHECK` constraint and `default 'normal'` so existing rows stay valid.

**`lib/tasks.ts`**:
- New `Priority` type (`"low" | "normal" | "high"`)
- `priority: Priority` field on the `Task` interface
- `createTask` accepts an optional `priority` input, defaults to `"normal"`, throws `RuleViolation` for invalid values
- `toTask` maps the `priority` column

**`app/api/tasks/route.ts`** — POST handler passes `priority` from the request body through to `createTask`.

**`lib/tasks.test.ts`** — three new tests under a `priority` describe block: default is `normal`, explicit `low`/`high` are stored correctly, invalid value throws `RuleViolation`.

Rollback SQL for the PR description: `alter table tasks drop column priority;` (SQLite 3.35+).
